visualCharacteristics.purpose: default: full-width image with an overlapping white text card (homepage, Adventures and Magazine listings); image-only: plain content-width image banner (FAQ and article pages)

contentPattern.structure: single row: image cell, optional content cell (heading, text, CTA). Image and text may also share one cell or sit in separate rows.
contentPattern.default: image + heading, paragraph and CTA link rendered as a card overlapping the bottom of the image
contentPattern.image-only: image only; any text renders plainly below the image

reuseGuidance: Use once at the top of a page. Default = image with overlapping text card; add image-only for a plain content-width image banner with no text.
